During the [[War in Kryta]], the explorable area of [[D'Alessio Seaboard (explorable area)|D'Alessio Seaboard]] can be accessed by talking to [[Jiaju Tai]] in [[Lion's Arch]].

==Getting there==
Talk to [[Jiaju Tai]] in [[Lion's Arch]].

== Notes ==
* [[Jiaju Tai]] will offer to take you to this area ''after'' [[Salma]] appears in [[Lion's Arch Keep]].
* The southern beach where you first appear in the area serves as a [[Resurrection Shrine]].
* There are no [[hard mode]] tasks to complete in this area; it cannot be [[vanquish]]ed.
* After the completion of the War in Kryta quest line, this area will be completely devoid of enemies, and the rope bridge is intact, making it easier to map for the [[Cartography]] title.
* If you are doing Wanted! bounties, the rope bridge (where the shrine would be in the mission) allows you to approach the fort from the rear. This helps for anyone having trouble with Cairn.
